title: Zephyr: DAD probe/conflict messages
description: Implement DAD probe and conflict messages in Zephyr
notes: 2026-08-27 completed isolated Zephyr/portable C DAD primitives in l2/dad.c/.h with CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6 build wiring and focused host tests. Implements exact RFC4862 64-byte Neighbor Solicitation probe and Neighbor Advertisement conflict response for RFC4944 short-address targets, canonical ICMPv6 pseudo-header checksums, strict fixed-length parse, hop-limit/source/destination/target/reserved/checksum validation, reserved-short rejection, identity-aware owner/challenger response filtering, and a bounded three-probe/conflict/cancel/finish state machine with no allocation. Canonical short_addr_dad.json 0x1234 probe/conflict bytes match exactly. Validation: strict AppleClang C23 -Wall/-Wextra/-Werror build, UBSan ctest 1/1, cppcheck warning/performance/portability clean, git diff check. Existing dirty ipv6_addr/short_addr/icmpv6 files were not touched.
